Blank Scroll.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting scrolls from Recipe Dungeons.

Bleached Bone.description: Crafting Material. These bones are commonly found littering the ground in Dragonfire Peaks.

Sticky Ichor.description: Crafting Material. Found by defeating bugs.

Faerie Dust.description: Crafting Material. Drops from Fae enemies, most commonly found in the Fae Wilds.

Radiant Shard.description: Crafting Material. Earned by completing the Dark Heart dungeons found in the Sky Realms.

Robotic Salvage.description: Crafting Material. Found by defeating robotic enemies in Neon City and Neon City, Luminopolis.

Golden Seashell.description: Crafting Material. Found most often in the Treasure Isles.

Shadow Shard.description: Crafting Material. Used to craft mounts and items on the Shadowy Market such as Shadow Caches. Can be found in Delves.

Water Drop.description: A drop of crystalline water. Used to craft seeds.

Meteorite Fragment.description: Crafting Material. Found only in the Primal Preserve tree canopy of the Jurassic Jungle.

Plasmium.description: Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Found by defeating robotic enemies in Neon City and Neon City, Luminopolis.

Irradiant Soul.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by composting the trophy of an Irradiant creature from the Sundered Uplands.

Unnatural Device.description: Crafting Material. Its eerie, irregular clicks and hums give no clue to its purpose or origin. Found rarely in the Ashen Wastes layer of the Sundered Uplands.

Ashfern Sporeling.description: Crafting Material. Depending on the magnification factor of your eyes, these lil' friendlies can be surprisingly cute! Found in the Ashen Wastes layer of the Sundered Uplands, and valued by the Fungi Scrollpeddlers and Thingshapers that frequent the region.

Ashen Soul.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by composting the trophy of an Ashen creature from the Sundered Uplands.

Irradiant Powercell.description: Crafting Material. Bristling with energy, this powerful resource can be used at the Sundered Uplands Workbench. Found in the Cloud Layer of the Sundered Uplands.

Depths Core.description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when opening fivestar dungeon vaults with basic keys or sparkling keys.

Kraken Shell Fragment.description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, after killing a specified mob which spawns after looting the chests.

Soul of the Depths.description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when opening fivestar dungeon vaults with basic keys or sparkling keys on Monday. Besides this, Soul of the Depths can be found in the Depths.

Runic Key Fragment.description: Found by defeating dungeons in the highest difficulty worlds.

Fish Bone.description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when defeating enemies and completing dungeons.

Ink Bladder.description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when defeating enemies and completing dungeons.

Depths Sand.description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when defeating enemies and completing dungeons.

Phoenix Mote.description: Found very rarely in the Sundered Uplands from bosses, invaders and dungeons. Phoenix Mote is one of the most time consuming materials to get. One of the best ways to get Phoenix Mote in short time is joining hosts when players are gathering in 8 people teams and farming Towers in Sundered Uplands biomes.

Sundercharge Crystal.description: Crafting Material. Usually claimed weekly after finishing the 72th wave (or above) in fivestar Dungeons in the Sundered Uplands, can also be found within Unstable Sunder-Ark Caches and Sundered Uplands Caches.

Delve Shadowkey Fragments.description: Crafting Material. Use to craft a Delve Shadowkey at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Delve Shadowkeys can open Shadowy Soul Vaults, found after defeating (every 3rd) Delve bosses. Found by completing dungeons in Fae Forest (Uber (4)) or higher Worlds.

Bottle.description: Crafting Material. Bottles are found growing wildly throughout the world or can be grown through Gardening.

Sunlight Bulb.description: Crafting Material. Found in the Giant Sunflowers that pepper the Peaceful Hills.

Wild Cupcake.description: Crafting Material. Found growing from the ground in Candoria, or grown through Gardening.

Enchanted Wood.description: Crafting Material. Usually found growing in the Fae Forest, Medieval Highlands, or Cursed Vale biomes, but also obtainable through Gardening.

Mushroom Chunk.description: Crafting Material. Gained through Gardening and from mushrooms found in the world.

Chestnut.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Chestnut Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Plasmic Solution.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Plasma Condensers, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Rich Fertilizer.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Unripe Fertilizer Heaps, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Steed Feed.description: Crafting Material that is used to craft mounts. Harvested from Steed Feed Seed, which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

Rich Mulch.description: A rich medium for growing plants. Used to craft plant seeds.

Pumpkin.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Pumpkin Seeds, which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

Spring Bloom.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Spring Bloom Seeds which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

Moonlight Temper.description: Allows more power from Moonlight Bulbs to be extracted by plants. Can be found inside Quality Compost Heap and Superior Compost Heap, craftable at a Harvesting Station.

Qubbage.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Qubbage Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Bunfeed.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Bunfeed Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Corn on the Cube.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Corn on the Cube Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Uggplant.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Uggplant Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Purp'lil.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Purp'lil Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Onionito.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Onionito Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Totter Tate.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Totter Tate Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Unicorn Chard.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Unicorn Chard Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Qumato.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Qumato Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Cinnamellon.description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Cinnamellon Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Concentrated Compost.description: Crafting Material. Obtained commonly from Compost Heaps, which can be crafted at the Harvesting Station.

Superior Organic Refuse.description: Crafting Material. Obtained from harvesting valuable Alchemy Plants. Organic Refuse be crafted into Compost Heaps at the Harvesting Station.

Quality Organic Refuse.description: Crafting Material. Obtained from composting vegetables at the Compost Bin or harvesting certain Alchemy Plants. Organic Refuse be crafted into Compost Heaps at the Harvesting Station.

Organic Refuse.description: Crafting Material. Obtained from composting harvestable materials at the Compost Bin or harvesting plants. Organic Refuse be crafted into Compost Heaps at the Harvesting Station.

Fertile Ash.description: Crafting Material.\n\nHarvested from Ash Piles, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

Cookie Musk.description: Can be found inside Superior Compost Heaps, craftable at a Harvesting Station.

Somber Soul.description: Crafting Material. Found in ore veins in the Cursed Vale biome.

Golden Soul.description: Crafting Material. Found rarely within ore nodes in most biomes.

Shapestone Ore.description: Crafting Material. A common, purple ore found in most biomes.

Primordial Flame.description: Crafting Material. An uncommon ore found within Shapestone, Formicite, and Infinium veins.

Glacial Shard.description: Crafting Material. An uncommon ore found only within Permafrost zones.

Infinium Ore.description: Crafting Material. A rare, golden ore found in most biomes.

Crystallized Cloud.description: Crafting Material. A unique ore found only in the Sky Realms.

Formicite Ore.description: Crafting Material. An uncommon, turquoise ore found in most biomes.

Cinnabar.description: Crafting material. A mysterious reddish ore native to the Forbidden Spires.

Irradium Ore.description: Crafting Material. A common, energy-laden ore found in the Cloud Layer of the Sundered Uplands.

Emberslag Ore.description: Crafting Material. A common, dense ore found in the Ashen Wastes layer of the Sundered Uplands.

Deepstone.description: Found rarely in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items and upgrading Mystic Gears.

Lichenstone.description: Produces 10 Lichenstone when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Chunk of Runic Ore.description: Found occasionally in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds.

Diamond.description: Crafting Material. Created at the Ringcrafting Bench.

Shadow Diamond.description: Crafting Material. Created at the Ringcrafting Bench.

Celestial Diamond.description: Crafting material. Created at the Ringcrafting bench.

Plain Metal Ring.description: Simple band of Formicite. Crafted at the Ringcrafting Bench.

Primal Loop.description: Primal Loops can be obtained by reaching paragon levels. They are basic materials to craft Crystal Rings for each class.

Mystic Loop.description: Mystic Loops can be obtained by reaching paragon levels in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. They are basic materials to craft Mystic Rings for each class.

Ringcrafter's Ticket.description: Used to craft Crystal 2 ringboxes at a Ringcrafting Bench Obtained by Loot Collecting Crystal 1 or Crystal 2 rings.

Gilded Ringcrafter's Ticket.description: Used to craft Crystal 3+ ringboxes at a Ringcrafting Bench Obtained by Loot Collecting Crystal 3, Crystal 4, or Crystal 5 rings.

Trovian Loop.description: Awarded for each PARAGON level earned.

Purifying Dragon Flame.description: Crafting Material used to forge Radiant equipment. Craftable at the Dragon Crucible.

Eye of Q'bthulhu.description: Forging Material. Found rarely as a drop from invaders and by Loot Collecting rare equipment.

Twice-Forged Shadow Soul.description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 2 equipment.

Thrice-Forged Shadow Soul.description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 3 equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Twice-Forged Shadow Souls.

Quad-Forged Shadow Soul.description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 4 equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Thrice-Forged Shadow Souls.

Penta-Forged Shadow Soul.description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 5 equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Quad-Forged Shadow Souls.

Pearl of Wisdom.description: Forging Material. Used to add new stats and stat boosts to equipment. Found rarely when defeating enemies and Loot Collecting equipment.

Candy Corn.description: Crafting Material. Used to craft items at the Shadowy Station in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub. Found by defeating Pumpkin dungeons in any biome or world.

Heart of Darkness.description: Rare Crafting Material. Found in Shadow Caches, which can be bought for Shadow Shards in the Shadowy Market.

Tentacle of Q'bthulhu.description: Forging Material. Found by defeating invaders and by Loot Collecting rare equipment.

Arena Coin.description: Spend with the Battle Broker to unlock arena rewards. The Battle Broker can be found in the Battle Station in the Trove Hub. Earned by competing in non-Bomber Royale PVP.

Forged Radiant Soul.description: Rare crafting material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Radiant equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Penta-Forged Shadow Souls.

Forged Stellar Soul.description: Rare crafting material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Stellar equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Forged Radiant Souls.

PembloCoin.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by lovers of canines. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

SkygoldCoin.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by sky-high rollers. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

NotTroveCoin.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by anarchists and those who rage against the established order. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

CurrentCoin.description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by those who like to clean-sweep the exchanges. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

Charged Circuit.description: Uncommon Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Can be crafted at the Resistor Workbench or found in Lesser Neon Caches.

Logic Loop.description: Uncommon Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Can be crafted at the Resistor Workbench or found in Lesser Neon Caches.

Memory Matrix.description: Uncommon Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Can be crafted at the Resistor Workbench or found in Lesser Neon Caches.

Neonium Coin.description: Earned only when playing from valid locations

Paragon's Mark.description: Very rarely obtained from Primal Paragon Pinatas. Used to craft items at the PARAGON WORKBENCH, in the PARAGON'S PALACE beneath the CLUB HOUSE in the Hub.

Sentience Shard.description: are Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Mostly btained from completing hourly Rampage Challenges (once per day with daily bonues), Legendary Tomes and Greater Neon Caches.

Infinity Frame.description: Crafting Material that is used to create terraformers.\n\nCraftable at the World Spring Bench.

Shaper's Star.description: Obtained by using a Shaper's Star Key on chests in the Shores of the Everdark. Shaper's Star Keys can be crafted at the Shadowy Market.

Tempered Block Element.description: Used by Gearcrafters to create gear of the Highest Quality. Found rarely in Gearcrafter's Vaults.

Block Element.description: Used by Gearcrafters to craft equippable Hats, Faces, and Weapons. Obtained by Loot Collecting equipment.

Negative Karma.description: Obtained by delivering WAYWARD SOUL TANGLES at the KARMAIC SHRINE. When you standing in the hub and looking at the Angel Statue, turn right and you will see some npcs, among them you can find a bench where you can convert various materials into Negative Karma.

Positive Karma.description: Obtained by performing acts of service. Find and speak with a MARTIAL ARTS envoy in the HUB to learn more. To gain positive Karma, head to the martial arts area located to the right of the Angel Statue in the Hub. You'll find an NPC there that offers quests rewarding Positive Karma.

Beginner's Incense.description: Used by the MARTIAL ARTS and sold by the Neon Punch Club in the hub!

Quality Incense.description: Used at the RELIC of PRESERVATION to convert MANTRAS into WEEK-LONG effects! One of the most important items for the late game, because you need these to craft the weekly light buff, which is mandatory for the endgame.

Crystallized Zephyr Of Mana.description: Obtanied from Cursed Skylands adventure worlds by defeating enemies. Used by Mysticists.

Crystallized Mana Ember.description: Obtanied from Igneous Islands adventure worlds by defeating enemies. Used by Mysticists.

Crystallized Globs Of Meta-Mana.description: Obtanied from Geode Topside adventure worlds by defeating enemies. Used by Mysticists.

Crystallized Aquatic Mana.description: Obtanied from Drowned adventure worlds by defeating enemies. Used by Mysticists.

Constellation Key.description: Constellation Keys can be used in the Star Chart to unlock branches or reset all used Celestial Spheres.

Astral Echoes.description: Astral Echoes can be found all over the world of Trove. Can be used to purchase items from The Celestial in the Hub. Also can be used to progress in the Star Chart.

Uncommon Condensed Memory.description: Acquired by Loot Collecting an Uncommon Mementos from a Delve. Used to craft various Delve portals.

Rare Condensed Memory.description: Acquired by Loot Collecting an Rare Mementos from a Delve. Used to craft various Delve portals.

Epic Condensed Memory.description: Acquired by Loot Collecting an Epic Mementos from a Delve. Used to craft various Delve portals.

Diamond Dragonite.description:
Crafting Material. A primordial shard used to craft items, including Primordial Dragons at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub. Obtained daily from filling the Star Bar and from opening Diamond Dragonite Pouches. 
 
 Good to know: If you have Patron and you fill the bar on Double Cubit Bar week, you get 3x times of the daily dragonites.

Flux.description: Crafting Material. Gain Flux from using the Loot Collector on equipment or selling items on the marketplace.

Glim.description: Trading Material. Exchange for items from the pirates of Treasure Isles. Obtained by Loot Collecting fish and breaking plants in the world.

Megaflux Tank.description: Crafted material used to efficiently store large quantities of Flux. Craftable at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench or rarely found in Titan's Treasure Chests.

Inert Geode.description: Inert Geode is a basic material in the Delves that can be used to craft items, it stands as a currency and also used to expand your Innert Geode storage.

Adventurine.description: Earned by completing daily Adventures, this valuable gemstone can be exchanged in Clubs and in the Hub for unusual and exotic goods.

Radiant Sovereign.description: You get rewarded with Radiant Sovereigns after buying specified credit/limited packs in the Store.

Chaos Core.description: Used to craft rare chaotic collectibles at the Chaos Core Crafter. Acquire from Chaos Chests and by Loot Collecting Chaos Chests rewards. Also used as currency at Corruxion Shop.

Cat's Eye Gemerald.description: Used to acquire various goods and services within Castle Catastra, where it can also be acquired.

Crystal.description: Found in Geode caves and large amount in some cave deadends.

Dragon Coin.description: Used to hatch Dragons at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub. Acquire by doing hourly challenges (Rampage doesn't count), crafting in the Bomber Royale Bench, completing Dragon Coin Digest and Dragon Hoard Deposition tomes or you can buy from the Dragon tab in the store.

Fragment of Wonder.description: This figment of fancy can be traded in to a Merchant of Marvels for a variety of wonderful goodies.

Bomber Royale Coin: Burnt Coin.description: Obtained by trading Season 1, Season 2, or Blast Coins at the Bomber Bench or by tomes. Used to craft past season's rewards

Bomber Royale Coin: Blast Coin.description: Obtained by successfully ranking in a Bomber Royale match or by the tome.

Heirloom Gemerald.description: Acquired rarely from within the halls of the Castle Catastra Delve biome.

Lunar Soul.description:
Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from the first six Shadowy Soul Vaults opened in Delves each week. 

Hint: Shadowy Vaults are spawning every 3rd boss in any type of Delves.

Ancient Scale.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting rare fish.

Enchanted Scale.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting Enchanted fish.

Basic Canned Fish.description: Canned common fish. Used to cook food at the Angler's Grill.

Premium Canned Fish.description: Canned rare fish. Used to cook food at the Angler's Grill.

Scale of the Depths.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting rare fish from the Depths.

Turtle Shell.description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting Turtles caught with the Turtle Trawler.

Select Canned Fish.description: Canned uncommon fish. Used to cook food at the Angler's Grill.

Mark Of The Angler.description:
Obtained by fishing while under the effects of the Aura of the Angler. Mark of the Anglers also used to craft items and dragons (Aquarus, the Aquarius Lord and Capricorn, Risen from the Depths).

Suggestion: Do Freshwater Fran fish quests to get significant amount of Mark of the Angler. You must do these on Tuesday, because you get more anglers due to Gathering Day Daily Bonus.

Griffon Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a griffon mount. Found very rarely in Cursed Skylands worlds.

Meownt Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a meownt mount. Found very rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower adventure worlds.

Centaur Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a centaur mount. Found very rarely in Uber Twilight (12) and higher adventure worlds.

Corgi Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a corgi mount. Found very rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower adventure worlds.

Llama Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a llama mount. Found very rarely in all adventure worlds.

Shmeep Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a shmeep mount. Found very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

Rat Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a rat mount. Found very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

Panda Talisman.description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a panda mount. Found very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

Carpet Talisman.description: Found very rarely in The Understacks in Delves of Depth 120 and deeper.

Acrobat Bark.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Hangs down from the ceilings in Tiers 2-4 of Moonglow Grotto.

Bond Crystalizer.description: A manifestation of the experiences you and your companion have shared. Used to level up companions. Craftable on the Crystallogy Workbench.

Builder's Blossom.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Blooms deep within Tiers 4-5 of Verdant Veins.

Cave Birds.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Flowers in Tiers 2-4 of Sunken Sunvault.

Cave Kelp.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Grows wild in Tiers 1-3 of Verdant Veins.

Cogwine.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Extracted from rare blooms in Tiers 2-4 of Verdant Veins.

Day Drop.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Grows throughout Tiers 1-3 of the Geode caves.

Dream Dew.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Nectar pulled from flowers in Tiers 1-3 of Moonglow Grotto.

Fireheart Flower.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Bold blooms rarely found in Tiers 4-5 of Sunken Sunvault.

Geminite.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Two bold colors adorn the sides of this ore found in Tiers 1-3 of Verdant Veins.

Moonlit Moss.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Clinging plants found throughout Tiers 2-4 of the Geode caves.

Queen Trumpets.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Majestic plants rarely found in Tiers 4-5 of Moonglow Grotto.

Sun Sap.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Liquid extracted from flowering pods in Tiers 1-3 of Sunken Sunvault.

Wallflowers.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Shy climbing plants that grow throughout Tiers 4-5 of the Geode caves.

Forge Fragment.description: A small piece of the forge used by the Shaper. Obtained by Loot Collecting Crystaline Gear.

Crystalline Core.description: Obtained daily by completing 5 Star Dungeons within the time limit and from opening Geodian Topside Caches.

Crystal.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Used as currency and crafting various items.

Accelerite.description: Reduces Reliquary and Companion Egg opening time by 2 hours.

Metamatter.description: Geode Crafting Material. Obtained from opening Reliquaries. Also used for upgrading Geode Modules.

Drillbit.description:
Geode Crafting Material. Obtained very rarely from Lesser Crystal Caches. 
 
Suggestion: Get Lesser Crystal Caches as much as possible by helping critters in Geode caves, so you can open caches to get Drillbit.

Ancient Gears.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Scavenged from the deepest corners of Tier 5 of the Geode caves.

Blazine.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Heat emanates from this ore found only in Tiers 1-3 of Sunken Sunvault.

Builderite.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. One of the Builder's favorite ores, found deep throughout Tiers 3-5 of the Geode caves.

Chronozine.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. The Ancients favored this ore that grows deep within Tiers 3-5 of Verdant Veins.

Everlight.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Travelers must delve far into Tier 5 of Sunken Sunvault to mine these fiery sunstones.

Gleamstone.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. An all-purpose ore, scattered throughout Tiers 1-3 of the Geode caves.

Lunarium.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Crescents adorn this ore found in the deepest parts of Tier 5 of Moonglow Grotto.

Mightstone.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. This fabled ore can only be found in the deepest parts of Tier 5 of Verdant Veins.

Moonstone.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Delicate, shimmery ore harvested only in Tiers 1-3 of Moonglow Grotto.

Quirkstone.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Confetti-covered ore found deep in Tiers 3-5 of Moonglow Grotto.

Sparkzite.description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Sparks sometimes fly from this ore that grows deep in Tiers 3-5 of Sunken Sunvault.

Nitro-Glitterine.description: Crafting Material. A sparkling, highly volatile ore. This ore is found uncommonly on the Geode Topside.

Veridium.description: Crafting Material. A crystalline green and blue ore that hardens reality against extra-dimensional invasions. This ore is found commonly on the Geode Topside.

Bardium.description: Crafting Material. A pulsing gold and blue ore that when touched fills ones head with musical inspiration. This ore is found rarely in Tier 5 of the Geode caves.

Builder's Box.description: Hidden deep within Geode, this box contains minor treasure (mostly Tier 1-2 materials).

Builder's Chest.description: Hidden deep within Geode, this box contains moderate treasure (mostly Tier 2-3 materials).

Builder's Vault.description: Hidden deep within Geode, this box contains great treasure (mostly Tier 4-5 materials).

Endurance Rune.description: Breaks sometimes when you take damage. Taking Damage can also trigger an Endurance effect, reducing damage taken, increasing Maximum Health, and granting Stability. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Restoration Rune.description: Breaks after defeating an enemy, restoring a charge of your equipped flask. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Replenishment Rune.description: Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, reducing your cooldowns by 33%. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Rally Rune.description: Breaks when an enemy is defeated, healing you for 50% of your health. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Abyssal Rune.description: Breaks when you would take damage from lava or Jellous's flames but grants immunity to the damage from lava and Jellous's flames. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Swift Rune.description: Breaks when you dash, increasing attack speed by 30% and movement speed by 10 for 60 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Abundance Rune.description: Breaks upon completing a dungeon, spawning a bonus chest. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Zephyr Rune.description: Breaks when you take damage from acid, making you immune for 10 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Repel Rune.description: Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering an explosion that knock backs enemies and roots them. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Harvest Rune.description: Breaks upon completing a dungeon, granting a buff that gives a chance to obtain Encrusted Runic Trunk when harvesting resources unique to Long Shade difficulty (15). Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Recursion Rune.description: Breaks when you land a critical attack, granting 35% Critical Damage for 60 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Condemn Rune.description: Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering a rage that increases your damage by 20%. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Fury Rune.description: Breaks sometimes when you deal damage. In addition hitting can trigger one of three Fury Rune buffs, increasing Critical Hit Chance, Critical Hit Damage, and overall Damage. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Pyric Rune.description: Breaks when you use your ultimate ability, creating a large fire around you burning your enemies for 10 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Focus Rune.description: Breaks when you spend all of your energy, replenishing your energy to full. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Empty Rune.description: Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting some Rune Fragments. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Shining Rune.description: Breaks when your magic find triggers, granting a Gearcrafter's Vault.

Ore Rune.description: Breaks as a result of mining resources, granting a bonus chance at a Miner's Trove when mining resources. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Rippling Rune.description: Breaks when catching a fish from a pool, granting a buff that can award Marks of the Angler when completing dungeons.

Blank Rune.description: Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting a few Rune Fragments. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Metallic Rune.description: Breaks on damage taken, granting a protecting shield that reduces damage by 20% for 10 seconds and increases Stability. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Depths Rune.description: Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting many Rune Fragments. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

Runic Ore.description: Found occasionally in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Mainly used for crafting items.

Runic Essence.description: Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench. Long Shade difficulty can be accessed via the Atlas.

Abyssal Essence.description: Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench. Can be also obtained from Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, by defeating enemies and opening vaults, after reaching a specific upgrade in the Rune Anvil.

Zephyr Essence.description: Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench. Can be also obtained from Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, by defeating enemies and opening vaults, after reaching a specific upgrade in the Rune Anvil.

Pyric Essence.description: Obtained by converting various LONG SHADE difficulty harvests at Saltwater Sam's Depths Workbench. Can be also obtained from Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, by defeating enemies and opening vaults, after reaching a specific upgrade in the Rune Anvil.

Rune Fragment.description: Used by Runecrafters to craft basic Runes, as well as materials for more advanced Runes. You can increases the Rune Fragment drops by unlocking various upgrades in the Rune Anvil.

Rune Slate.description: Used to craft various Runes in the RuneCrafting Bench.

Abyssal Coral.description: Found in the Hollowed Dunes biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items, spawn bosses from the obelisks.

Zephyr Coral.description: Found in the Weather Wastelands biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items, spawn bosses from the obelisks.

Chocolate Algae.description: Produces 10 Chocolate Algae when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Pyric Core.description: Found in the Dragonfire Peaks biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items and spawn bosses from the obelisks.

Cursed Coral.description: Produces 10 Cursed Coral when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Depths Coolant.description: Produces 10 Depths Coolant when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Pyric Coral.description: Found in the Cerise Sandsea biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items, spawn bosses from the obelisks.

Pyrite Seashell.description: Produces 10 Pyrite Seashell when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Surface Dried Seaweed.description: Produces 10 Surface Dried Seaweed when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Cinnabark.description: Produces 10 Cinnabark when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Depths Mana.description: Produces 10 Depths Mana when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Depths Mold.description: Produces 10 Depths Mold when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

Irradiated Rune Fragment.description: Found in the Sundered Uplands biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Can be used to spawn obelisk boss and crafting items.

Water Gem Dust.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Water Gems and crafting Air Gem Sparks. Gained from Loot Collecting Water Gems.

Air Gem Dust.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Air Gems and crafting Air Gem Sparks.

Fire Gem Dust.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Fire Gems and crafting Fire Gem Sparks. Gained from Loot Collecting Fire Gems.

Cosmic Gem Dust.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Cosmic Gems and crafting Cosmic Gem Sparks. Gained from Loot Collecting Cosmic Gems.

Primal Gem Shard.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Crystal Gems and craft rare items. Crafted at the Sundered Uplands bench. Also you can craft these for a total of 12 Gem Spark (4 Gem Spark of each Gem type).

Mystic Gem Shard.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Mystic Gems and craft rare items. Found rarely in Long Shade difficulty (15) or Depths Delves. Also you can craft these for a total of 80 Gem Spark (20 Gem Spark of each Gem type).

Water Gem Spark.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Crystal Water Gems. Gained from Loot Collecting Crystal Water Gems.

Air Gem Spark.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Crystal Air Gems and crafting Air Gem Dusts.

Fire Gem Spark.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Crystal Fire Gems and crafting Fire Gem Dusts. Gained from Loot Collecting Crystal Fire Gems.

Cosmic Gem Spark.description: Crafting Material. Used to Level Up Crystal Cosmic Gems and crafting Cosmic Gem Dusts. Gained from Loot Collecting Crystal Cosmic Gems.

Crystal Gem Converter.description:
Used to convert Stellar gems into Crystal Gems. Cab be crafted at the Sundered Uplands bench. 
 
 Suggestion: It's more worth to buy it in the Store for 10.000 cubits, because it requires large amount of Sundercharge Crystal to craft, which are pretty rare materials, which can be used to craft Sundered Upland items. Must use on 3 star Empowered Gems. Lesser Gems are more easy to get in Crystal rarity.

Mystic Gem Converter.description:
Used to convert Crystal gems into Mystic Gems. Crafted at Adventure's Crafting Bench in the Gems tab.

Suggestion: If you are approaching endgame, you should consider the fact that you will only craft Mystic Gem Converters instead of buying them in the Store for Cubits. When you are in the endgame, you can easily get souls on Monday by completing fivestar dungeons and opening vaults with basic or sparkling keys.

Class Gem Key.description: Use this key on an Everdark Vault. Everdark Vaults appear in the Shores of the Everdark after completing a colosseum dungeon. This key grants an Empowered Gem for the active class at the time of use.

Class Gem Key Fragment.description: Crafting Material. Combine three fragments at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench to get a full Class Gem Key. Found in Empowered Gem Boxes or crafted at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.

Bound Brilliance.description: Crafting Material. Used at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench to craft Gems Augments and upgrade gem stats. Obtained from the Weekly Class XP / Highest (atleast 25) Paragon Levels and Highest (Specified Weekly Class) (25) Paragon Levels and from Events.

Binding Darkness.description: Crafting Material. Tendrils of deepest shadow, forged into inextricable fetters. Used at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench to craft Gems Augments. Obtained in Gem Booster Boxes and rarely from World Bosses.

Glittering Horseshoe.description: Gem Level Up Booster. Increases Level Up chance by 50%!

Lapis Luckbug.description: Gem Level Up Booster. Increases Level Up chance by 300% and Double Level Up chance by 500%!

Ninth Life.description: Gem Level Up Booster. Increases Level Up chance by 4000% and Double Level Up chance by 1000%!

Tenth Life.description: Mystic Gem Level Up Booster. Increases Level Up chance by 4000% and Double Level Up chance by 1000%!

Golden Gem Key.description: Use to get the rarest tier of rewards from a lesser gem box. Obtained uncommonly from Gem Booster Boxes or granted as a bonus when purchasing multiple Gem Booster Boxes in the Store.

Builder's Rough Focus.description: Gem Augment. This item gives a small boost to one stat on a gem, and that gem's Power Rank. Used at the Gem Forge. Crafted at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.

Builder's Precise Focus.description: Gem Augment. Gives a moderate boost to one stat on a gem, and that gem's Power Rank. Used at the Gem Forge. Crafted at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.

Builder's Superior Focus.description: Gem Augment. This item gives a large boost to one stat on a gem, and that gem's Power Rank. Used at the Gem Forge. Crafted at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.

Contained Chaos Spark.description: Gem Augment. A spark of primal chaos, bound in a containment field and awaiting a gem to interact with. Used to reselect stats on gems at the Gem Forge. Crafted at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.

Contained Chaos Flare.description: Gem Augment. A flare of primal chaos, bound in a containment field and awaiting a gem to interact with. Used to move a stat boost on gems at the Gem Forge. Crafted at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench.

Empowered Gem Fragment.description: Crafting Material. Used to craft Stellar Empowered Gem Boxes or Class Gem Key Fragments at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Gained from Loot Collecting Empowered Gems or Prism of Light (if you've already got every aura from Prism of Light).
